```python
import re

def text_match_one(text):

```

The pattern `ab+` matches an `a` followed by one or more `b`s anywhere in the string. `text_match_one("ac")` returns `False` because there is no `b` after the `a`. The lazy `ab+?` in the team note matches the same strings, so the result is identical.
